title: Sea Power | Luxurious 30A Beach Rental | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Luxury Seagrove Beach home near Santa Clara access with private heated pool, fire pit, LSV, bikes, bunk loft, pet friendly, and upscale interiors.
description_expanded: Sea Power Features - 3 min stroll to the Santa Clara Beach Access. Beach service and restrooms available at this location. - Large Private Pool. Depth reaches 5 feet. - Pool heating included for arrivals October 1 - April 30 - Pet Friendly for 2 dogs, 60 pounds or less, non-aggressive dogs only. Must get approval from Exclusive 30A and pay a nonrefundable pet fee. Unauthorized pets will result in fines and possible eviction - Access to 6 Taxi Bikes, serviced regularly by La Dolce Vita to ensure they are in top shape for your arrival - Access to a 6-seater LSV (golf cart) serviced by La Dolce Vita. Must sign a waiver to gain access to the LSV (golf cart) - Fenced-in sun deck with poolside lounge seating, natural gas grill, and outdoor dining table for 6 - 1st Floor Main Living Area with Smart TV, reclining chairs and sofas, and electric fireplace for ambiance - 1st Floor Dining area with seating for 6, bar seating for 3, and kitchen island seating for 4. - 1st Floor Gourmet Kitchen with high end appliances including Wolf oven and range. Keurig and drip coffee maker available - Beverage fridges on the 1st and 3rd floors - Smart TVs with streaming available, including complimentary access to HULU with sports and local channels - King Suite on the 1st floor - Deluxe Bunk Loft on the 3rd Floor with a full bath, wet bar, living area with TWO TVs, and private balcony featuring a glimpse of the Gulf - Covered, furnished front porch - Multiple balconies including an open-air balcony on the 3rd floor with glimpses of the Gulf - 2nd Floor Laundry room with HE Washer and Dryer - Driveway parking for 4 vehicles (RV, trailer, and street parking are not allowed) - Outdoor shower and foot hose - Fire pit with natural gas (on a timer) and Adirondack seating set next to the pool - Twice weekly trash pickup - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee Welcome to your luxurious getaway in Seagrove! This exquisite property offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and coastal charm. Nestled just a stone's throw away from the pristine shores of the Santa Clara Beach Access, this five-suite plus deluxe bunk room home boasts unparalleled relaxation and recreation opportunities. As you step into this coastal oasis, you are greeted by spacious interiors adorned with elegant furnishings and modern amenities. The open concept living area is ideal for gatherings, featuring plush seating arrangements, a cozy electric fireplace, and large windows that bathe the space in natural light. The gourmet kitchen is a chef's delight, equipped with state-of-the-art appliances, ample counter space, and a convenient breakfast bar. Step outside to discover your own private oasis, complete with a sparkling pool and poolside firepit with seating set. Spend your days lounging by the pool, soaking up the sun, or hosting al fresco gatherings with your crew. For those seeking adventure, access to Taxi bikes and an LSV (golf cart) are provided, offering easy access to the nearby beach, quaint shops, and dining destinations. Experience the ultimate coastal getaway at this stunning Seagrove retreat. With its unbeatable location, luxurious amenities, and endless opportunities for relaxation and recreation, this property is sure to create memories that will last a lifetime. Book your stay today and discover the beauty of beachside living in style. The 30A area is continually growing and evolving. As a result, nearby construction, renovations, or public works projects may occur during your stay. While we strive to provide an exceptional experience, these activities are beyond our control. Refunds or discounts cannot be offered for construction-related noise, disruptions, or changes in views. ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***
